author: dabaseballking
body: I was temp banned for three days for saying "I am not a big fan of staff, they abuse their powers a lot so in general i just do not like staff members". I was banned for that, i was not insulting anyone, trying to cause trouble, just telling staff what i have experienced with other servers staff. I should be unbanned now, because thats abusing their powers.
